notes.title: Updating achievements calculations
notes.content:
In this patch we've fixed methods related to achievements calculations and how the achievements are synced with the Steam API.

It should help our players with cases, when after playing the game some of the achievements were not unlocked / synced with their Steam player profile.

Have a good day and happy gaming!

notes.title: New words generator and UX improvements as we're preparing for Switch release!
notes.content:
[h1]New update is now live![/h1]

In past week we've been working on new quality update for Lear Words - Use Syllables. We've updated in-game navigation and UX, especially focusing on long-term experience when playing multiple levels in a row.

After our previous patch, that improved syllables generation for English and Polish, this time we've focused on our other supported languages: German, French, Spanish, Portuguese, Italian and Dutch.

For these languages we've updated the syllabification algorithm and fixed any leftover words that weren't included in the translation process and were leftover with their default English translation.

Come and try our newest build!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43872946/c4e97dcf22671781095fedb231c2e3867c32520f.png[/img]

We're currently starting to work on a set of new levels for Learn Words with our [b]Last Qubit team[/b]. We'll also be thankful for all provided feedback so that we'll be able to add more UX and quality improvements in our future releases!

[h1]We're coming to Nintendo Switch![/h1]

We've just recently finished our works on the preparation of our game for its Switch release! We're glad that we've been able to work with this platform and so that the porting process came to its succesful end!

Come and visit us on our Nintendo Store page in next couple weeks to support the project!

notes.title: First gameplay patch
notes.content:
[h1]What's new?[/h1]

We come back to you - we've prepared a series of patches for our next weeks with Learn Words - Use Syllables, trying to improve the overall experience and usability of the game.

As for first big patch - we've finally reworked the syllables generation and handling system. We've rechecked all existing in-game syllables and from now on the syllables you'll encounter in the game should have correct spellings and the randomization chance for the words that from now on will appear on the levels was also modified for more varied experience with the achieved progress.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43872946/c4e97dcf22671781095fedb231c2e3867c32520f.png[/img]

In [b]Last Qubit[/b] we hope that this new patch will allow for smooth learning of new words :) We hope that you'll enjoy this new update and will have good portion of fun with the game!

[h1]What's next to come?[/h1]

As we're currently finishing our tests for new settings screen, we'll be uploading a new patch with them next week. From this date the players will be able to play the game in windowed mode, modify the gameplay resolution and adjust music/sounds with convenient sliders :)

We've also started working on a new content patch, containing a couple new categories to add some additional gameplay to the experience. Some of the new categories will also be marked and divided based on the difficulty to add some additional complexity and challenge for our most advanced players :)

Stay tuned!

notes.title: Release news and future plans
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

We're excited about our game's release and that there are already people invested into the game, having fun and providing us with valuable feedback :)

We're currently getting back to the more standard workflow in order to prepare improvements for the game based on your feedback. Today we've started work on some UX for the syllables' selection for some rare cases when the players are using their XBox controllers and we're working on some improvements on the number of additional parametrization options for the Settings screen.

As for our next plans - after our initial patches will be released, our next plans are to create a new set of levels for the game. We're planning to create new type of a high-level, group category, to be able to create bigger sets of levels grouped under a same, similiar theme and to open the game for better difficulty parametrization. 

Based on our currently collected feedback we've noticed that our players strongly differ in their knowledge levels, especially for the newly learnt languages, and being able to smoothen the learning curve of the game will be one of our future close for the closest game expansions.

And to finish up - thank you again for your interest in our game! We'll be posting regular updates to let you know how the progress is going and what new functions are being added to keep you in the loop as the game will be expanding :)
